plan.title: Let deft check resolve the OVPR pin package root under node_modules

narratives.Description: resolveCheckFrameworkRoot never considers node_modules/@deftai/directive-runtime. On a clean OVPR checkout without .deft/core, deft check fails closed with FRAMEWORK_ROOT_MISS even when the pin package is installed.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Extend packages/runtime/src/check.ts resolveCheckFrameworkRoot to accept the installed pin package root when it looks like a runtime package, keeping existing .deft/core, source, and DEFT_ROOT candidates.
2. Update packages/runtime/src/check.test.ts and FRAMEWORK_ROOT_MISS guidance so OVPR pin-root success is covered and messaging no longer teaches only directive init.
narratives.UserStory: As an OVPR consumer, I want deft check to find the pinned runtime under node_modules, so that ordinary check works after a normal package-manager install.

narrative.Acceptance: Given node_modules/@deftai/directive-runtime is installed and looks like a runtime package root, when resolveCheckFrameworkRoot runs, then it returns that path.

items.title: Keep legacy candidates and miss guidance

narrative.Acceptance: Given no pin package root and no .deft/core or source root, when check resolves framework root, then it still fails closed and FRAMEWORK_ROOT_MISS does not teach only directive init as the recovery.

expected_outputs: check.test.ts passes for pin-root resolution and updated miss guidance
